text: Apex Group Ltd. is majority-owned by the US private-equity firm Genstar Capital; Mubadala Investment Company, Abu Dhabi's sovereign investor, holds a minority stake alongside Carlyle.
short: Genstar Capital is Apex Group's majority owner; Mubadala holds a minority stake

source.name: Apex Group: Apex secures equity investment from Carlyle & Mubadala
source.quote: We are proud to now have the equity backing of three highly reputable institutions, including our majority owner Genstar, and now joined by Mubadala.

additionalSources.name: Genstar Capital: TA Associates Announces Strategic Growth Investment in Apex Group
additionalSources.quote: Apex is majority-owned by Genstar Capital
